teaser.text: BeOne Medicines AG is a cancer-drug company built around medicines it owns, especially BRUKINSA. To understand its business, follow a treatment from scientific idea to sale, then watch how the resulting dollar is divided among factories, partners, researchers and the company itself.

stock.title: BeOne stock forecast
stock.meta_description: BeOne's stock forecast weighs scenario prices, cash generation, valuation and the risks to BRUKINSA, TEVIMBRA and its pipeline.
stock.opening: BeOne's weighted forecast is HKD 278.80 by October 2027. BeOne's outcome turns on BRUKINSA’s demand, TEVIMBRA’s uptake, and whether the pipeline converts into approvals and launches.
stock.closing: The full BeOne memo also answers how its business works, who its rivals are, how management is executing, and what risks could change the outcome.

blocks.heading: Where could BeOne's shares be by October 2029?

paragraphs.text: The forecast points to a weighted share price of HKD 278.80 by October 2027, HKD 305.92 by October 2028 and HKD 335.61 by October 2029. Including dividends, which are forecast at zero, those prices imply returns of 24%, 36% and 50% from today’s HKD 224.40.
The range is much wider than the weighted path: the October 2029 bear outcome is HKD 85.63, while the bull outcome is HKD 730.63. The probabilities are 30% bear, 50% base and 20% bull.

blocks.heading: What has to go right or wrong for BeOne?

paragraphs.text: The bear case gives EBIT of $1.040 billion. Revenue reaches $9.0 billion and an 86% gross margin produces $7.74 billion of gross profit. Costs of $6.70 billion leave little operating leverage. This reflects competition, reimbursement pressure and delayed pipeline contribution. The bull case gives EBIT of $5.450 billion. Revenue reaches $15.5 billion, while a 90% margin produces $13.95 billion of gross profit. Costs of $8.50 billion leave unusually strong leverage, requiring successful approvals and sustained patient gains.

blocks.heading: How much cash does BeOne really make?

paragraphs.text: Free cash flow also has competing definitions. The company’s own count excludes intangible-asset purchases, while a broader analytical measure includes them. Subtracting stock pay produces a still lower “real free cash flow” measure because dilution is an economic cost to owners, even when it is not a cash payment. Research spending already passes through operating cash flow, and lower capital spending may not persist.

paragraphs.text: That cash is useful, but it may fund trials, factories or licensing deals. The business itself is valued at 6.3 times trailing revenue. Its trailing P/E, the price paid for each dollar of annual profit, is 66.5x, while its next-twelve-month P/E is 37.2x. The lower forward multiple assumes roughly 79% earnings growth.

earnings.title: BeOne earnings date, guidance and results
earnings.meta_description: BeOne’s next results are expected on November 5, 2026; guidance covers revenue, GAAP and non-GAAP operating income.
earnings.opening: BeOne’s next results are expected on November 5, 2026. BeOne should be watched for whether BRUKINSA reaches regulators for first-line mantle cell lymphoma as promised.
earnings.closing: The full memo also explains BeOne’s business, its rivals, its management and its risks.

paragraphs.text: The August outlook raises the expected revenue and both operating-profit ranges, even as planned research and selling expenses also rise. BRUKINSA provides the main commercial momentum. If sales grow faster than the organization’s costs, BeOne gains operating leverage: each additional dollar of sales contributes more to profit.

The two profit measures require care. GAAP follows standard accounting rules. Non-GAAP operating income removes items such as share-based compensation, depreciation and amortization. Those costs have not vanished: shares still dilute ownership, and buildings and equipment still wear out. The non-GAAP figure is therefore a useful management view, but it is not a replacement for GAAP. The fact that both profit measures improved by the same amount makes the forecast revision more meaningful.

blocks.heading: Did BeOne keep its 2025 profitability promise?

paragraphs.text: In early 2025, management promised positive full-year GAAP operating income and delivered it. GAAP includes stock compensation, which makes the achievement more meaningful than a profit measure that excludes it. BeOne reported about $447 million of GAAP operating income and about $942 million of free cash flow in 2025. Free cash flow measures cash generated after operating needs and equipment spending, so it need not equal accounting profit.

blocks.heading: How have BeOne’s last eight reported periods changed?

paragraphs.text: Cash improved alongside earnings, and the eight-quarter sequence shows operating income moving from losses to profits and then to larger gains. That pattern is stronger evidence than a single quarter. Management also raised annual revenue and operating-income guidance while increasing expected operating spending, which sets a higher test for the commercial engine.

paragraphs.text: The next near-term test is whether BRUKINSA reaches regulators for first-line mantle cell lymphoma as promised.
